title: Fix win streak calculation to use consecutive wins from match history

requirements.text: Fix the current win streak calculation in the ProfilePage so it counts consecutive wins from the most recent match backwards through match history, stopping (resetting to 0) as soon as a loss is encountered. The streak must be derived from win/loss match records, not from days played or availability data.

quotes: It seems to be adding streaks as days played instead of using match data for consecutive wins without a loss
the streak logic must loop through win/loss records per match, not count the number of days a user was available

acceptanceCriteria: Current streak on the Profile tab increments only on consecutive wins from the latest match backwards
Current streak resets to 0 immediately when a loss is encountered in the match history
Current streak does NOT count days with availability or days played

requirements.text: Fix the best (all-time) streak calculation in the ProfilePage `computeBestStreak` helper so it scans the full match history in chronological order, increments a running counter on each win, resets it to 0 on each loss, and returns the highest value the counter ever reached. This must use win/loss match records exclusively.

quotes: Best (All-Time) Streak: Take all match logs sorted by date (oldest first), Walk through each match one by one, Keep a running counter -- increment on win, reset to 0 on loss, Track the highest value the counter ever reaches

acceptanceCriteria: Best streak on the Profile tab reflects the longest unbroken sequence of consecutive wins across all match history
Best streak resets its running counter to 0 on any loss and tracks the maximum
Best streak does NOT count days with availability or days played
Example: matches W,W,L,W,W,W,L,W yields best streak of 3

requirements.text: Fix the win streak calculation displayed on the LeaderboardPage so it also uses consecutive wins from match history (same logic as REQ-1 and REQ-2), not days played or availability counts.

quotes: the streak section in the profile tab wasn't calculating correctly

acceptanceCriteria: Win streak values shown on the Leaderboard are consistent with the corrected streak logic used in the Profile tab
Leaderboard streak resets on any loss in match history

constraints: Streak calculation must be based solely on win/loss match records, never on availability data or days played
Do not change the backend data model or match history storage schema
nonGoals: Adding new match history data entry UI
Changing how wins/losses are recorded in the backend
Modifying the leaderboard ranking algorithm beyond the streak display
